disposition_reason: Table 1 prints summary statistics for cadmium, lead, copper, iron and zinc in 142 raw cow milk samples from Pernambuco.

study.design: farm survey of raw milk from individual cows on 14 extensive and semi-intensive dairy farms
study.origin: Garanhuns microregion, Agreste mesoregion, Pernambuco, Brazil
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion of 5 mL milk, ICP-OES (duplicate)
study.lod_text: LOD in acid digest: Cd 0.012, Pb 0.036, Cu 0.14, Fe 0.85, Zn 0.93 µg/L; all samples above LOD
study.qa: blank subtraction; multi-element standards; recovery 90-110%, RSD <10%; no CRM named
